decisions: Minutes of the July 9, 2025 board meeting approved with an amendment correcting the Q2 budget variance figure.
Cost-reduction initiative approved targeting $120,000 in savings by December 31, 2025; Pierre Dubois to present itemized plan at the September board meeting.

Formal contract renewal negotiations with Northwind Partners to begin no later than August 20, 2025; Margaret Holvan to lead negotiations; tiered service proposal including strategic advisory services to be submitted to Northwind Partners by August 27, 2025.

Technology infrastructure upgrade approved in principle; Phase 1 (discovery and vendor selection) to proceed in Q4 2025 with a budget cap of $25,000; full implementation deferred to 2026; Aiyana Park to report vendor evaluation findings at the November board meeting.
Recruitment for two Senior Analyst positions approved to commence immediately with a target start date of November 1, 2025.
Next board meeting scheduled for September 10, 2025.
